avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces tofacitinib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; recommend alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance immune activation, potentially reducing therapeutic effect of JAK inhibition in autoimmune conditions
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; counsel on alternative immune support strategies

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase tofacitinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; limit consumption

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive immunomodulation; limited clinical data
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor clinical response

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases tofacitinib bioavailability and systemic exposure, elevating risk of adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Strictly contraindicated; recommend alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase tofacitinib absorption and peak plasma levels
caution_foods.action: Administer consistently with or without food; counsel on consistent intake pattern

monitoring_notes: Assess for signs of infection, thrombosis, and lipid abnormalities. Monitor CBC, liver function, and lipid panel periodically, and counsel patients to avoid live vaccines and report any immunosuppression-related infections.
